newsitem.title: UK: GUS up on reports of British Land venture.
newsitem.headline: GUS up on reports of British Land venture.

text.p: Shares in Great Universal Stores Plc rose in early trading on Monday after reports that the retail group was in talks to inject some of its property assets into a joint venture with British Land Plc.
GUS shares were up 16p at 651-1/2p by 0836 GMT, while British Land was up 2p at 519-1/2.

The Sunday Times said the aim of the planned venture was to maximise the performance of GUS's property portfolio, valued at some 900 million stg. It said the move would free GUS to realise cash for reinvestment in higher-yielding ventures.
Last year GUS shares surged after the company's one billion stg acquisition of U.S. information services group Experian.
No-one at GUS or British Land was immediately available for comment.
